title: Emberbane
body:
"An Adurite battleaxe, repurposed to ignite trees with the flames inside of them."

Emberbane

The Emberbane is a double-bladed battle-axe forged from Adurite. It is obtained through completing a puzzle involving multiple separate side-quests. It is also part of the Expert Pack as a gamepass.

The Emberbane is obtained by fusing a Meteor Core, an Adurite Key, and a Burning Skull together in a cave behind a secret destructible wall. This axe has the unique ability to strike 2-3 times in a single swing on all types of wood with the notable exception of the following trees: Hallow Trees, Magma Trees, and Ash Trees. While each individual hit is roughly as powerful as those delivered by the Refined Axe, these hits can stack together for a small boost in cutting speed.

The Emberbane also has a special bonus against Magma Trees and Ash Trees. Instead of striking multiple times, the Emberbane gains massively increased power, allowing it to cut Magma Trees in 3-5 swings (a Tall Refined Axe typically takes 16-17 swings) and Ash Trees in 1-2 swings (compared to 4-5 swings from a Tall Refined Axe.)

Emberbane Quest

**While not necessary, it is advised to do this quest on a solo server to prevent item theft.

Three special items are required to complete this quest. Before starting, note that to complete this quest, you must at least have the following:

  • $47,000 to buy a Refined Pickaxe, Refined Axe, and Refined Chisel.
  • Around $24,000 to buy enough Bombs to explode walls at the Magma Cave entrance in Mike's Mines, the wooden seal on Skull Rock in Ferwater, the entrance to the Acidlands (or, alternatively, the Refined Scooba Tank to drive to the Acidlands beach), and the unmarked entrance to the Emberbane ruins.

The following lists the first three steps required to accomplish the Emberbane quest. Complete them in any order.

Meteor Core

  • Obtain a Meteor Core.
    • Meteor Cores have been buffed to have a 100% chance to spawn in both Magmafied Meteors and Electrified Meteors.
    • Meteors land about every hour or so. If you want to know when a meteor lands, ask the Jr. Scientist for $3500.

Adurite Key Sidequest (Pedestal Puzzle v2)

  • Obtain the Adurite Key.
    • Initiate the Pedestal Puzzle by pressing the secret Red ? Button in the ceiling of the underground lake in Mike's Mines.
      • You should hear a special sound effect that verifies the Pedestal Puzzle is activated. Three Pedestals across the entire map of Oaklands should now display a neon red ring around them.
    • Purchase a Refined Pickaxe, Refined Axe, and Refined Chisel at the Oak Depot for $47,000.
    • Travel to Alan's Auto-Logistics in the Finlay Taiga. Find the pedestal on the rock in-front of the store. Place the Refined Axe on this Pedestal.
    • Travel to the Lost Woods in the Finlay Farlands (North Finlay). Find the pedestal in the center of the forest. Place the Refined Pickaxe on this Pedestal.
    • Travel to the Oke Desert in Ferwater. Find the pedestal inside the Canyon in the center of Oke Desert. Place the Refined Chisel on this Pedestal.
    • Once all three items have been placed in their respective pedestals, travel to the Acidlands via any route. Once inside, travel upwards and find the final Pedestal.
    • Collect the Adurite Key that has spawned on this Pedestal.

Burning Skull Sidequest

  • Obtain the Burning Skull.
    • Bring at least six Small Bombs or equivalent from a shop that sells explosives, such as Mike's Mines shop, Dugg's Digging, or the Pirate Boat shop. Place the bombs in your truck.
    • Travel to Oke Desert in Ferwater. Find Skull Rock with the explosives in tow.
      • Use explosives on the wooden seal on Skull Rock. Retrieve the Skull quest item. Place the Skull in your truck.
      • Alternatively, travel to the Acidlands and purchase a weapon. Kill Skeletons in the Acidlands or the Lost Woods until you receive a Skull mob drop.
  • Travel to the Magma Caves in Mike's Mines with the Skull.
    • Use explosives to unlock the entrance to the Magma Caves.
    • Place the Skull next to any Lava pool. Watch the skull to see if it darkens.
    • After a few minutes next to the Lava pool, the name of the Skull should change to the Burning Skull.

      Once you have all three materials, proceed with the following:

      Fusion into the Emberbane

      • Acquire Two Small Bombs, which can be purchased from Mike's Mines or any other explosives shop.
      • Travel to the Finlay Farlands (North Finlay). Look for the back entrance to Flowering Meadows. To the left of this entrance is an unmarked breakable wall. It is tinted a slightly different brown than the rest of the hillside.
      • Use the two Small Bombs you brought to destroy the wall. The entrance will be a hole, make sure to take the crafting materials with you when you drop down, as the hole is very small. Make sure you have all three materials at once before trying to fuse them - they may despawn if placed outside of your base. This passageway is no longer a one-way drop and the Fusion/Gravity coil is no longer a necessity.
      • Lay the items in their correct slot as indicated by the images above it:
        • The left spot holds the Meteor Core.
        • The middle spot holds the Adurite Key.
        • The right spot holds the Burning Skull.
      • Once all items are inserted into their corresponding spots, all of the slots will close, consuming the materials. The center wall will begin to raise, followed by an explosion. The Emberbane will fall onto the ground to be claimed.

      Other Tips

      • Be sure to carry the supplies in a crate or using one of the grabbers. This way, all of the materials will be easy to transport up to the top of the plateau, and down into the crafting chamber.
      • If this guide was too confusing for you check out some of the following resources!
        • This Youtube video for a video guide by FrumpyPlays.
        • This YouTube video for a video guide by Theofficialbrick.

      Trivia

      • The Emberbane is the most difficult axe to obtain as of v1.36.0.
      • Prior to v1.51.0, the Emberbane's inventory icon was that of the Tall Refined Axe, albeit with a black handle and red axe head.
      • Using 8 Emberbane can make a DESTROYER OF WORLDS.
